page: Running Hono on Google Cloud Run serverless platform. Container-based: any runtime supported via Dockerfile. Requires Google Cloud account with billing. CLI: gcloud CLI for management. Installation: brew install gcloud-cli (macOS) or other platforms. Authentication: gcloud auth login. Setup: create project, set project ID/number, add billing account, enable APIs (run.googleapis.com, cloudbuild.googleapis.com), update service account permissions. Hello World: npm create hono@latest my-app, select nodejs. Configure port 8080 in src/index.ts. Run: npm run dev, access http://localhost:8080. Deploy: gcloud run deploy my-app --source . --allow-unauthenticated. Customize runtime: add Dockerfile for Deno, Bun, or custom Node.js. Questions: How do I set up Google Cloud Run? How do I deploy? How do I change runtimes? What port is required?

sections.manifest: Google Cloud CLI setup. Install: brew install gcloud-cli (macOS), or other platforms. Authenticate: gcloud auth login. Creates gcloud command for managing Cloud platform. Questions: How do I install gcloud? How do I authenticate?

Google Cloud project setup. Create project: gcloud projects create --set-as-default --name='my app' (auto-generates ID). Get project ID/number: gcloud projects list with filters. Find billing account: gcloud billing accounts list. Link billing: gcloud billing projects link $PROJECT_ID --billing-account=[id]. Enable APIs: gcloud services enable run.googleapis.com cloudbuild.googleapis.com. Update permissions: gcloud projects add-iam-policy-binding with serviceAccount and roles/run.builder role. Wait ~30 seconds after project creation. Questions: How do I create project? How do I link billing? Which APIs do I need? What permissions?

Hello World application. Create: npm create hono@latest my-app, select nodejs template. Install: npm i. Configuration: port must be 8080 for Cloud Run. File: src/index.ts with serve() from @hono/node-server. Update port from 3000 to 8080. Run locally: npm run dev, access http://localhost:8080. Questions: Which template? What port? How do I run locally?

Deployment to Google Cloud Run. Command: gcloud run deploy my-app --source . --allow-unauthenticated. Process: interactive prompts (region selection). Build: Cloud Build handles containerization. Requires project setup complete. Questions: How do I deploy? What's the deploy command? What's --allow-unauthenticated?

Custom runtimes via Docker. Add Dockerfile for alternative runtimes: Deno, Bun, custom Node.js. Optional .dockerignore. References: Node.js deployment docs, Bun Docker guide, Deno Cloud Run tutorial. Benefits: use preferred runtime, customize container. Questions: How do I use Deno? How do I use Bun? How do I customize container? What's Dockerfile?
